items.item: There is no greeting or hero; the header has a title and a date-range control
items.evidence: No greeting or hero. The header holds h1 'Vận hành kho: Tổng quan trong ngày', a warehouse select #wh and a 'Làm mới' button. The only range control (.rg 7/14/30 ngày) is inside the chart widget, not the header, and the header shows no date range.

items.item: Each KPI tile shows label, value and a signed change with its comparison period, without decorative icon tiles
items.evidence: No icon tiles, and label/value/delta are present in renderKpis. The comparison period is missing on most tiles: only the first says 'so với hôm qua'; others show '+8,4%', '-0,8đ', '+0,2đ', '+5', '-3' with a target or note instead of a period. Tile 5 is '8 xe còn lại' with no sign.

items.item: Charts use bars for comparison and lines for trends; no pie, donut or gauge; axes have labels and units
items.evidence: The trend is a line chart (#chart paths) and the zone capacity uses horizontal progress bars; there is no pie, donut or gauge. But the axes have no titles or units: the y-axis shows bare '1.600 / 1.200...' and the x-axis shows '22/10...'. There is no 'đơn' unit and no axis label. The legend is the only label.

items.item: A needs-attention list links to pre-filtered list pages
items.evidence: The 'Việc cần xử lý' table (#tasks) has no <a> or href. Rows have only a 'Hoàn tất' toggle button, and the Khẩn/Chưa xong filters apply in-page via the .tf handler. Nothing navigates to a filtered list page.

items.item: Numbers use locale formatting and tabular figures
items.evidence: fmt=n=>n.toLocaleString('vi-VN') is used for chart ticks and tooltip. Dates and times use vi-VN. KPI values are '1.126', '96,2%', '2.418'. The .num class (font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums) is on KPI values, deltas, zone percentages and task refs. KPI values are hard-coded strings, not formatted, but they are correctly localized. Chart axis text and the due-date column lack .num.

items.item: Each widget has loading and empty states
items.evidence: There are no loading, skeleton or spinner states anywhere; all widgets render synchronously from mock data. The only empty state is #empty ('Không có việc nào phù hợp bộ lọc.') for the task table. KPIs, the chart and zones have no empty state.

notes: Clean, restrained Tailwind page: no greeting, icons, gradient, glass, emoji, tracked-uppercase labels, hover-lift, large radius (radii 4/6/8), sidebar or card-in-card. Status colours are semantic only (red/amber/blue/slate), so rainbow-status is not flagged. Audit score is 90; the only violation is two low-contrast cells (3.08:1 and 2.88:1) in the completed (opacity-60) task row. Failures are functional gaps: the date-range control is not in the header, KPI comparison periods are inconsistent, chart axes have no titles or units, attention rows are not links, and there are no loading states. I did not open the full-page screenshot; the judgement rests on the markup and the first-viewport screenshot.
